settings.name: Al-Asar International Model School
settings.location: Lahor (Chota Lahore), Swabi, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
settings.schoolTimings: Monday – Thursday: 8:00 AM – 1:30 PM | Friday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM
settings.admissionProcedure:
1. Complete and submit the online admission application form or visit the school office.
2. Submit student's Birth Certificate / B-Form copy along with 2 passport photographs.
3. Short friendly assessment and parent discussion.
4. Confirmation and issuance of admission slip.
settings.eligibilityInfo: Children seeking primary education in Playgroup, Nursery, Prep, and Grades 1 through 5.
settings.requiredDocuments:
• Student B-Form / Birth Certificate (copy)
• Father or Guardian CNIC (copy)
• 2 Passport-size photographs
• Previous School Leaving Certificate (for Grade 1 and above, if applicable)
settings.feeInfo: For current admission and fee structure details, please contact the school administration office.
settings.heroIntroduction: Providing children with a positive learning environment, foundational education, good manners, self-confidence, and character development in Lahor, Swabi.
settings.welcomeText: Al-Asar International Model School is dedicated to nurturing young minds during their most crucial foundational years. Situated in Lahor (Chota Lahore), Swabi, we provide child-friendly primary education focused on basic academic concepts, discipline, respect, and creative growth with caring and attentive teachers.
settings.aboutText: Al-Asar International Model School serves children and families in Lahor, Swabi and adjacent areas. As a dedicated primary institution, we focus on fundamental literacy, mathematical thinking, Islamic and moral values, and student confidence in a safe, disciplined environment.
settings.mission: To provide young children with a strong educational foundation and help them develop good habits, confidence, discipline, and positive character.
settings.vision: To help young students become confident, responsible, and successful learners equipped for future educational milestones.
settings.principalMessage: Welcome to Al-Asar International Model School. Our primary goal is to foster a safe, cheerful, and disciplined learning environment where children build solid foundational skills and moral values. We partner with parents to ensure every child is guided with care, patience, and encouragement.

classes.name: Playgroup (Pre-Nursery)
classes.description: Play-based early learning focusing on motor skills, phonics sounds, colors, socialization, and confidence.

classes.name: Nursery
classes.description: Introduction to letter tracing, number recognition, basic Urdu & English vocabulary, and structured habits.

classes.name: Prep (Kindergarten)
classes.description: Preparation for formal schooling with reading readiness, basic addition/subtraction, writing skills, and manners.

classes.name: Grade 1
classes.description: Foundations of reading comprehension, basic mathematics, Urdu reading, General Knowledge, and Islamiat.

classes.name: Grade 2
classes.description: Sentence formation, mental math, primary science concepts, handwriting improvement, and moral lessons.

classes.name: Grade 3
classes.description: Developing independent reading, word problems in mathematics, general science explorations, and conversational confidence.

classes.name: Grade 4
classes.description: Enhanced conceptual learning in Science, Mathematics, English grammar, Social Studies, and Islamic studies.

classes.name: Grade 5
classes.description: Comprehensive primary curriculum mastery, problem-solving, moral development, and preparation for middle school.

subjects.name: English
subjects.description: Phonics, reading fluency, vocabulary, spelling, and sentence construction for early learners.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.description: Number sense, basic arithmetic, counting, shapes, measurements, and simple word problems.

subjects.name: Urdu
subjects.description: Huroof-e-Tahajji, reading comprehension, handwriting (Khushkhati), and spoken expression.

subjects.name: General Science
subjects.description: Exploring the natural world, living things, plants, animals, weather, and healthy living habits.

subjects.name: Islamiat & Nazra Quran
subjects.description: Basic Islamic ethics, Duas, Kalimas, Tajweed basics, good manners (Adaab), and prophetic stories.

subjects.name: Art & Drawing
subjects.description: Creative coloring, sketching, paper craft, and fine motor skill enhancement.

activities.title: Physical Sports & Play Activities
activities.description: Healthy physical exercise, tag games, friendly sports races, and outdoor play that develop motor skills, teamwork, and agility.

activities.title: Drawing & Creative Coloring
activities.description: Engaging art sessions where children express their creativity, explore colors, and enhance their concentration and coordination.

activities.title: Reading Circles & Storytelling
activities.description: Interactive classroom story sessions that cultivate an early love for books, improve listening skills, and expand vocabulary.

activities.title: School Celebrations & Special Days
activities.description: Observing National Days, Pakistan Day, Eid celebrations, and Annual Prize Distribution events to build student confidence.

events.title: New Academic Admissions Open for Primary Classes
events.description: Admissions are currently underway for Playgroup, Nursery, Prep, and Primary Classes 1 through 5. Parents are welcome to apply online or visit the school desk.

events.title: First Term Parent-Teacher Meeting
events.description: A constructive session for parents to discuss their child’s academic progress, daily classroom engagement, and moral development with class teachers.

events.title: Primary Health, Cleanliness & Good Habits Week
events.description: Special morning assembly talks and practical exercises on hand hygiene, neat uniforms, polite greetings, and respectful classroom conduct.

gallery.title: Annual School Gathering & Community Function
gallery.caption: Parents, students, and teachers gathered for the grand annual community ceremony under the Al-Asar canopy.

gallery.title: Annual Prize Distribution & Merit Awards
gallery.caption: Celebrating student academic achievements with merit shields, trophies, and certificates on stage.

gallery.title: Primary Classroom Learning & Engagement
gallery.caption: Students actively engaged with foundational learning materials, books, and attentive primary school teachers.

gallery.title: Morning Assembly & Student Presentations
gallery.caption: Disciplined morning assembly in the courtyard featuring student speech presentations and daily prayer.

gallery.title: Sports Day & Physical Activity Sessions
gallery.caption: Active outdoor games, team sports, and agility exercises promoting health and teamwork.
